content_of_post_to_comment: My French friend told me, with despair, "Why are so many Americans gleeful about what's happening to France? We look at America as a friend. We would never do the same if you were in trouble."
comment: There’s a difference between criticizing a country’s politics and enjoying its humiliation. Social media blurs that line, turning other people’s political struggles into a spectator sport. Friendship gets lost when schadenfreude becomes a national identity.
